name: TrayTooltip
where: tray icon tooltip: the app's name, then the status headline, which is cut with … so the whole fits; screen readers name the tray icon by it (I42)

name: PausedUntil
where: status box at the top and tray icon tooltip; replaces 1T.4, whose Arabic said يعود للعمل (I36); {0} is the time of day, in Arabic as 5:12 م

name: CountdownNote
en: Locking in {0} · move the mouse or press a key to cancel
ar: القفل بعد {0} · حرّك الماوس أو اضغط على مفتاح للإلغاء
where: corner notification; replaces 1T.28, which named only the mouse (I32)

name: CountdownNoteAway
en: Away actions in {0} · move the mouse or press a key to cancel
ar: إجراءات المغادرة بعد {0} · حرّك الماوس أو اضغط على مفتاح للإلغاء
where: corner notification, when locking is off; replaces 1T.29, which named only the mouse (I32)

name: WarnMeDetail
en: Move the mouse or press a key during the countdown to cancel the lock
ar: حرّك الماوس أو اضغط على مفتاح للإلغاء
where: main settings list; replaces approved line 25, which named only the mouse (I32: the same change in the Warn me row)

name: OptionsNotUsed
en: These options were not used: {0}. To use them, right-click the padlock, choose Quit SteppedOut, and start SteppedOut again with them.
ar: تعذر تطبيق الخيارات ‪{0}‬ لأن SteppedOut يعمل بالفعل. انقر بزر الماوس الأيمن على أيقونة القفل بجوار الساعة، واختر "إنهاء SteppedOut"، ثم شغّله مرة أخرى بالخيارات نفسها.
where: message box when SteppedOut is started again with options while a copy runs; names the tray menu's Quit SteppedOut as the menu shows it (I14)

name: SaveFailedTitle
where: corner notification, once, when Windows refuses to let SteppedOut write config.json (another program holds it, or the folder is read-only)

name: SaveFailedDetail
en: Your changes are used until SteppedOut quits. The log in the settings folder says why.
ar: تظل التغييرات مطبّقة حتى تنهي SteppedOut، ثم تُفقد. يوضح السجل في مجلد الإعدادات السبب.
where: corner notification, under Settings couldn't be saved

name: SaveFailedFooter
en: Changes couldn't be saved. They're used until SteppedOut quits.
ar: تعذر حفظ التغييرات. تظل مطبّقة حتى تنهي SteppedOut، ثم تُفقد.
where: settings window, bottom left, in place of Changes are saved automatically. while the last save failed

name: SnoozeReminder
where: tray menu, the first row while a break or eye-break note with Snooze is showing, so the keyboard and screen readers can reach Snooze (I13)

name: SettingsSections
where: settings window: what screen readers call the row of tabs (Locking, Away and back, …), never shown (I35)
